1.
None present for the petitioners to press this present petition even in the revised call.
2. Learned AGA for the State is present.

3. This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 05.11.2022 in Case Crime No. 0080 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 313, 494 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Kanpur Nagar.
4. In such circumstances, present petition is dismissed for want of prosecution.
